units.why: Julien cares about p95/p99 and the single worst frame. Every advance runs in units of unit_ops charged operations and every unit is timed. A frame is at most one unit per worker, so the worst unit bounds the worst frame.
units.verdict: SMOOTH if the worst unit of the whole run is at most target_max_unit_ms, else JANK (step-2 exit criterion; reported per rung, does not stop the climb)

track_gates.why: Build-step exit criteria, frozen before any v7 rung ran.

cost_per_event_flat.measure: ops / fired events at the largest passing rung over the smallest rung

useful_work.on: every passing rung with at least 1000 fired events

smooth.on: every passing rung: worst unit at most target_max_unit_ms

carry_bound.why: the relativistic carry must stay bounded (a random walk over a million collisions would reach about 1000 quanta)
carry_bound.rule: every carry component (energy, px, py) at most 64·S·m_max·γ_max³, with S the law's 4-momentum scale (F = 2^16 in v0, 2Q in v1) and γ_max = Γ_max/F over genesis and final velocities (Γ = ⌊F·Q/√(Q²−|k|²)⌋ as a γ estimate)
